newsitem.title: LATVIA: VITRANSAUTO IN H1 LOSS OF 11,813 LATS.
newsitem.headline: VITRANSAUTO IN H1 LOSS OF 11,813 LATS.

text.p: Vitransauto, included on the Riga bourse's secondary list, posted a 11,813 lats loss on turnover of 1.79 million lats during first half-year of 1997, the stock exchange said on Tuesday.
The production costs of Vitransauto reached 1.78 million lats, leaving a gross profit of 1,384 lats, the bourse said in a statement.
The company spent 66,080 lats on administrative charges. It had 89,309 lats income from other business activities and earned 128,387 lats in interest income.
Vitransauto paid 181,065 lats in interest, the statement also said.
The company's balance sheet total came to 2.29 million lats on June 30 and tangible assets were worth 1.5 million lats, the statement said.
Vitransauto has equity of 750,000 lats, long-term liabilites of 683,136 lats and short-term liabilities of 329,411 lats.
The company has provisions for liabilities and charges of 38,528 lats.
